goal.text: Make your room safer before an earthquake.

intro.text: Your family is getting ready for earthquakes. Help fix your room!

hint.text: Heavy things can fall. Where are they safest?

lesson.text: Before an earthquake, make your home safer. Keep heavy things low and beds away from windows.

choices.label: Hang a big picture over the bed
choices.feedback: A heavy picture can fall on your bed. Hang it somewhere else.

choices.label: Put heavy things on a low shelf
choices.feedback: Keep heavy things on low shelves, not high ones.

choices.label: Move the bed under the window
choices.feedback: Window glass can break. Keep your bed away from windows.

choices.label: Put books on top of the tall cabinet
choices.feedback: Things up high can fall when it shakes. Keep them low.
